headline: Appointment — NTPC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Shri Diwakar Nath Misra as Non- Executive Director of the company w.e.f. October 23, 2026.
summary: Shri Diwakar Nath Misra assumed charge as Additional Director (Government Nominee Director) on the Board of NTPC Limited effective October 23, 2026.
raw_text: NTPC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Shri Diwakar Nath Misra as Non- Executive Director of the company w.e.f. October 23, 2026.

enrichment.background: Shri Diwakar Nath Misra is a 2000 batch IAS officer of the Assam-Meghalaya cadre, currently serving as Additional Secretary, Ministry of Power, with over two decades of administrative experience across power, finance, commerce, petroleum, and public administration. (Filing p. 2)
